The individual keys on the QWERTY keyboard lack distinct separation and uniform geometry. Several keys appear to merge into one another or have irregular, non-rectangular shapes, failing the structural rigidity expected of physical hardware.
The connection point of the red stylus to the device body is ambiguous. The tether seems to emerge from nowhere or blend into the casing without a clear port or loop structure.
